plan.title: Improvement Comparison
plan.subtitle: Analyzing if girls and boys are improving equally in physical metrics

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM endline

panels.title: Average shuttle run time by gender
panels.sql: SELECT "Gender" AS gender, AVG("shuttle_run") AS avg_shuttle_run FROM (SELECT "Gender", "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_run FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Gender", "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_run FROM endline) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend of sit ups
panels.sql: SELECT "month" AS month, SUM("sit_ups") AS total_sit_ups FROM (SELECT "month", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "month", "Sit ups" AS sit_ups FROM endline) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 children by improvement in shuttle run
panels.sql: SELECT "Child name", "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_run_baseline, "Shuttle run sec" AS shuttle_run_endline, ("Shuttle run sec" - "Shuttle run sec") AS improvement FROM (SELECT "Child name", "Shuttle run sec" FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT "Child name", "Shuttle run sec" FROM endline) ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 10
